# ZebraByte

> ZebraByte combines cyber security, privacy, compliance, accessibility and secure managed infrastructure with an open-source compliance platform.

ZebraByte focuses on practical security and continuous compliance: security assessments, hardening, incident support, GDPR/privacy, NIS2, audit readiness, secure managed hosting and digital accessibility. The website also preserves and extends the open-source Probo compliance platform experience, including its documentation, developer APIs, compliance portal architecture and upstream endpoint agent where technically applicable.

## LLM resources

- [Documentation index for LLMs](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/llms-docs.txt): Links to documentation pages in clean Markdown.
- [Complete documentation corpus](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/llms-full.txt): Documentation corpus in one text file.
- [XML sitemap](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/sitemap-index.xml): Discover public pages.

For a token-efficient Markdown version of a supported page, request its canonical URL with the `Accept: text/markdown` header:

`curl -H "Accept: text/markdown" https://www.zebrabyte.ro/docs/product/getting-started/product-overview`

## ZebraByte services

- [ZebraByte homepage](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/): Cyber security, privacy and compliance.
- [Cyber Security](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/cyber-security): Assessment, hardening, continuous security and incident support.
- [Secure Managed Hosting](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/secure-hosting): Security-first managed infrastructure.
- [Digital Accessibility](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/accessibility): WCAG assessment, remediation guidance and tooling.
- [Compliance Portal](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/products/compliance-portal): Security and compliance document sharing.
- [Open-source deployment](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/docs/deployment/self-hosting): Self-host the compliance platform.
- [Endpoint Agent](https://www.zebrabyte.ro/download): Endpoint posture agent download. The currently distributed binary remains the upstream open-source Probo Agent until a separate ZebraByte build is released.

## Upstream attribution

The compliance website/platform experience is derived from the MIT-licensed Probo project. Upstream technical names, API paths, agent binary names or historical case studies may remain where changing them would misrepresent the actual software or source material. Such material is explicitly attributed and must not be interpreted as a ZebraByte customer claim or ZebraByte-authored upstream release.
